reason: Implement the first V2.1 real product loop by adopting mature OSS as the runtime: Synapse for Matrix state, Element Web for the unified conversation shell, and mautrix-whatsapp for the first real platform bridge. Yance is limited to exact upstream pinning, configuration/bootstrap, one runtime module, one minimal replayable Element patch for the documented missing global persistent right-workspace mount, Electron shell wiring, licenses/notices, and compatibility contracts. No second Yance message state machine, Matrix store, protocol implementation, or per-platform product page is authorized.

ossFit.elementPatchAllowedOnlyForVerifiedGap: Element Web v1.12.25 runtime Module API can register logged-in navigation renderers and room-header actions but exposes no global persistent right-panel renderer; Container=right only relocates an existing room widget. The authorized patch may only add the missing global Yance workspace mount and must preserve Element's existing right-panel resize/hide persistence semantics.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: Exact upstream repositories, 40-character commits and license records are absent before implementation
The unified Element shell has no persistent global Yance right workspace before the authorized module/patch
The right workspace must be hideable, resizable, restorable and must not control Matrix synchronization or bridge runtime state
WhatsApp enters the same Matrix/Element conversation shell and no WhatsApp-only product page or Yance message state machine is introduced
Bootstrap rejects mutable refs, short commits, pin drift and patch drift
